name: 49486-shortprefill-dsv4flash-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, expert parallel ON, all2all over allgather_reducescatter. Single node, in-process.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM -- a sparse-attention MoE, fp4 routed experts over a blockwise-fp8 dense body, bf16 activations. The checkpoint's own config.json is authoritative.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 4, bounded at 200 requests / 3600 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, NO prefix buckets -- every prompt is independently drawn faker prose of exactly 1920 tokens (min = max = 1920) and every output exactly 64 tokens (min = max = 64), greedy (temperature 0.0), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied and the wire prompt is exactly the declared length. The fixed lengths are part of the declaration and must not be relaxed.
purpose: A document summarizer condensing roughly 2,000-word articles into brief abstracts for four concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash

tensor-parallel-size: 4

enable-expert-parallel: true

all2all-backend: allgather_reducescatter

# MANDATORY ON THIS HARDWARE: the in-tree alternative for this architecture declares
# `capability.major in [10, 12]`, Blackwell only; this one declares [9, 10] and covers SM90.
attention-backend: FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV4

kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# MANDATORY ON THIS HARDWARE. `auto` resolves this checkpoint's MXFP4 routed experts to the
# Marlin expert kernel on SM90, and that worker dies with SIGSEGV seconds after the weights
# finish loading -- the engine never reaches its first request. The in-tree device gate for this
# backend is `(9, 0) <= capability < (11, 0)`, so SM90 is covered; it is out of the `auto`
# priority list only because of an unrelated MTP bug, and no speculative decoding runs here.
moe-backend: triton_unfused

# This checkpoint's tokenizer needs it; `auto` does not load.
tokenizer-mode: deepseek_v4

max-model-len: 4096

dtype: bfloat16

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
